input: Get a professional watch battery replaced today

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the watch brand and model determines whether a general jeweler can handle it or if it requires an authorized service center, especially for luxury or water-resistant watches.
The user's city or neighborhood determines which specific shops are nearby and reachable today.
A hard time deadline within today (e.g., must be done by noon vs. by 8 pm) affects which shops are still open and whether same-day walk-in service is feasible.
Whether the user will visit in person or needs a courier/mail-in option changes the entire logistics of the task.
Whether the user already has a shop in mind or needs help finding one changes whether the next step is navigation or research.
Water resistance re-sealing and pressure testing after battery replacement is a meaningful upsell some shops offer — knowing if this matters affects which service provider to choose.
A budget ceiling determines whether a mall kiosk ($10–15) or an authorized brand service center ($50+) is the acceptable option.

gold.taskTitle: Get a watch battery professionally replaced today
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to have the battery in a watch replaced by a professional service, with the job completed within today.

questions.title: What is the brand and model of the watch?
questions.description: Identifies whether the watch requires a specialist (e.g., luxury brand, diver's watch) or if any local jeweler or kiosk can handle it.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you currently in?
questions.description: Determines which nearby shops and service centers are actually accessible today.

questions.title: What is the latest time you need this done by today?
questions.description: Sets the hard deadline that filters out shops that close too early or cannot commit to same-day turnaround.

questions.title: Will you drop the watch off yourself or need it collected?
questions.description: Determines whether walk-in service is the path or whether a courier or mail-in option needs to be arranged.

questions.title: Do you already have a shop in mind, or need one found?
questions.description: Decides the immediate next action — either navigating to a known shop or researching and vetting a new one.

questions.title: Does the watch need to stay water-resistant after the replacement?
questions.description: Determines whether a basic battery swap suffices or if the service must include re-sealing and pressure testing, which not all shops provide.

questions.title: What is your budget limit for this service?
questions.description: Sets the price ceiling that distinguishes between low-cost kiosk options and premium authorized service centers.
